generic.Defined scope/population: Claims in the current audit sample carrying a coverage position and an open or recently closed reserve

steps.title: Open the sampled claim Coverage tab in Guidewire ClaimCenter

steps.title: Compare coverage analysis to the policy record in ClaimCenter

Compare limits, deductible and endorsements cited in the coverage analysis against the policy as written
Done when every cited term is confirmed or flagged as misstated on the audit worksheet

Pass when each coverage term cited in the analysis matches the policy record or is flagged

steps.title: Score the liability determination in the ClaimCenter file notes
sop: Read the liability analysis notes and locate the stated comparative or contributory fault percentage
Confirm the percentage is supported by named facts, statements or evidence rather than a bare conclusion

steps.title: Test reserve adequacy on the reserve worksheet in Microsoft Excel

Compare the total to the current damages evaluation and note any material shortfall or redundancy

steps.title: Flag unexplained reserve movement in the ClaimCenter financial history
sop: Open the reserve transaction history and list every movement over 25% from the initial reserve

steps.title: Record element scores on the audit record in Guidewire ClaimCenter

verify: Open the saved audit record and confirm no element is blank
Pass when each of the three elements carries a score and an evidence link

steps.title: File the completed assessment to the claim file repository

Pass when the assessment package opens from the repository with its timestamp intact

steps.title: Pull the disputed-score queue from the BI/reporting platform

steps.title: Assign a second blind auditor for each disputed file

Pass when every rubric line splitting twice or more has an action with an owner

steps.title: Update calibrated scores on the audit records in ClaimCenter

Pass when the disputed queue returns zero records for the closed cycle

generic.Defined scope/population: Sampled claim files assessed against the claims-handling documentation standards checklist

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every checklist item answered with coverage, liability, damages and recovery outcomes recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Checklist items answered equals checklist items presented for the claim type
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Completed checklist stored on the claim with the completion timestamp and user
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Incomplete items routed for supervisor exception approval with the reason recorded
generic.Test population: All closure checklists completed on claims closed in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where any checklist item is waived without a recorded supervisor approval
generic.Exception handling path: Waived items escalated to the supervisor and recorded with approver name and reason
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Items worked in order rather than bulk-ticked, with each answer evidenced in the file
generic.Evidence location: Closure checklist on the claim in Guidewire ClaimCenter with documents in the claim file repository

steps.title: Open the closure checklist on the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the closure checklist against the claim and confirm the correct claim type variant loaded
Work each item in order rather than bulk-ticking the list
Done when the checklist is open and the first item is answered
verify: Check the checklist variant against the claim line and type
Pass when the loaded checklist matches the claim line and type

steps.title: Confirm coverage, liability and damages are documented
sop: Confirm a documented coverage position, liability decision and damages evaluation exist in the file
Answer each corresponding checklist item and reference the supporting document
Done when all three items are answered with document references
verify: Open the referenced documents from the claim file repository
Pass when each of the three items resolves to a retrievable document

steps.title: Confirm subrogation and salvage were evaluated
sop: Check the file for a recorded subrogation and salvage evaluation outcome
Confirm a documented no-pursue decision is recorded where recovery was not pursued
Done when the recovery evaluation outcome is recorded on the checklist
verify: Read the recorded no-pursue rationale where recovery was declined
Pass when every no-pursue decision carries a documented rationale

steps.title: Confirm correspondence obligations are complete
sop: Confirm the final letter to the insured or claimant was issued and filed
Check no outstanding correspondence obligation remains open on the file
Done when the correspondence checklist items are answered
verify: Search the repository for the final letter against the claim number
Pass when the final letter is retrievable from the claim file repository

steps.title: Route incomplete items for supervisor exception approval
sop: Identify any checklist item that cannot be completed before closure
Route each for supervisor exception approval and record the approver and reason
Done when every incomplete item carries a recorded approval and reason
verify: Filter waived items for a missing approver or reason
Pass when no checklist item is waived without a recorded supervisor approval

steps.title: Confirm the checklist is complete before status change
sop: Review the checklist for unanswered items before requesting the closure status change
Complete or escalate every remaining item
Done when no checklist item is left unanswered
verify: Attempt the closure status change and observe the checklist gate
Pass when all checklist items are answered before the claim can be set to Closed

generic.Defined scope/population: All indemnity payments, expense payments and recoveries on the claim being closed
generic.In-scope period: Financial transactions from first payment to the closure preparation date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Transaction status, amount, payee and recovery disposition populated on every transaction
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total disbursed in the payment system reconciles to total paid on the claim record
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Payment reconciliation saved against the claim with the reconciliation date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Pending, held, rejected or void transactions logged with the resolution applied
generic.Test population: Every financial transaction on the closing claim
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where any transaction remains in Pending or Held status at closure
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved transactions block closure until issued, cleared, voided or written off
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every recovery either received or formally written off before closure
generic.Evidence location: Claim financials in Guidewire ClaimCenter with disbursements in the payment subrogation system

steps.title: List all payments on the claim in Guidewire ClaimCenter
sop: List every indemnity and expense payment on the claim with its current status
Confirm each payment shows Issued or Cleared status
Done when every payment is listed with its status confirmed
verify: Re-query the payment list after any status change
Pass when every payment on the claim is Issued or Cleared

steps.title: Resolve pending, held, rejected and void transactions
sop: Identify any transaction in Pending, Held, Rejected or void-and-reissue state
Resolve each by releasing, reissuing or cancelling and record the resolution
Done when no transaction remains in an unresolved state
verify: Re-run the transaction status query on the claim
Pass when no transaction remains in Pending or Held status on the closing claim

steps.title: Confirm every recovery is received or written off
sop: List subrogation, salvage, deductible and second-injury fund recoveries on the claim
Confirm each is received or formally written off with the write-off recorded
Done when every recovery carries a received or written-off disposition
verify: Check each write-off carries an authorisation record
Pass when every recovery write-off shows a recorded authorisation

steps.title: Reconcile total paid to the payment subrogation system
sop: Extract total disbursed for the claim number from the payment subrogation system
Compare it against total paid on the claim record and investigate any difference
Done when the reconciliation agrees or the difference is explained
verify: Re-run the reconciliation after any correcting transaction
Pass when total disbursed reconciles to total paid on the claim record

steps.title: Confirm vendor and expert invoices are settled or accrued
sop: Check for outstanding vendor and expert invoices against the claim
Confirm each is received and paid or properly accrued before closure
Done when every known vendor obligation is paid or accrued
verify: Compare the vendor assignment list against invoices received
Pass when every vendor assignment has an invoice paid or an accrual raised

steps.title: Record the payment finalisation confirmation on the claim
sop: Record the confirmation that payments and recoveries are finalised on the claim
Attach the reconciliation output as supporting evidence
Done when the confirmation is recorded with its reconciliation attached
verify: Re-open the claim note and check the attachment opens
Pass when the finalisation confirmation carries an attached reconciliation

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims closed in the period feeding the cycle time, reserve accuracy and payment timeliness metrics
generic.In-scope period: Claims with a closure date within the current reporting period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loss date, report date, assignment date, closure date, initial reserve and final incurred populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Closed claim count in the feed equals closed claim count on the claim system for the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Feed validation output saved with the run date and the feed version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims rejected by the feed validation logged with the field corrected and the rerun date
generic.Test population: Every closed claim entering the closure metrics feed for the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a closed claim carries a null loss, report, assignment or closure date
generic.Exception handling path: Rejected claims corrected at source in ClaimCenter and re-fed before the metric cut
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Line of business, cause of loss and closure reason codes populated for segmentation
generic.Evidence location: Feed output in the enterprise data warehouse with source fields in Guidewire ClaimCenter

steps.title: Test cycle time date completeness in the data warehouse
sop: Profile closed claims for loss date, report date, assignment date and closure date
List every claim with a null in any of the four dates
Done when the date completeness profile is produced
verify: Re-profile after the source corrections are applied
Pass when no closed claim enters the feed with a null loss, report, assignment or closure date

steps.title: Confirm initial reserve and final incurred are present
sop: Extract the initial reserve and the final incurred for every closed claim
List claims missing either value so reserve accuracy can be computed
Done when both values are confirmed present or listed as missing
verify: Re-extract after the missing values are populated
Pass when initial reserve and final incurred are both recorded on the closed claim

steps.title: Confirm payment issue dates are captured
sop: Check payment issue dates are captured against every payment on the closed claims
Correct missing issue dates in ClaimCenter so payment timeliness can be measured
Done when every payment carries an issue date
verify: Re-query payments for missing issue dates
Pass when no payment on a closed claim is missing its issue date

steps.title: Confirm segmentation codes are populated
sop: Check line of business, cause of loss and closure reason codes on every closed claim
List claims carrying a blank or default code for correction
Done when segmentation code completeness is confirmed
verify: Re-check the corrected claims for controlled-list codes
Pass when every closed claim carries populated segmentation codes

steps.title: Run the closure feed validation
sop: Run the closure feed validation for the period and capture the rejection list
Record the run date and feed version alongside the output
Done when the validation completes with its rejection list captured
verify: Compare the feed claim count against the claim system closed count
Pass when the feed count equals the closed claim count for the period

steps.title: Correct rejected claims and re-run the feed
sop: Route each rejected claim to the handler for the missing metric field
Re-run the feed once corrections are applied and confirm the rejection clears
Done when the rejection list is empty for the period
verify: Re-run the validation after the final correction pass
Pass when the closure feed returns no rejected claims for the period

generic.Defined scope/population: All exposures on the claim carrying an outstanding indemnity, expense or recovery reserve
generic.In-scope period: Reserve position at the closure preparation date for the claim
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Outstanding indemnity, outstanding expense, recovery reserve and closing movement rationale populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Outstanding reserve after the closing movement equals zero on every exposure
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Closing reserve movement and rationale note stamped with the user and timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reserve releases beyond handler authority logged and routed for approval
generic.Test population: Every exposure on the claim being closed
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a non-zero outstanding indemnity or expense reserve remains at closure
generic.Exception handling path: Over-authority releases held until the approver records the decision
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Closing reserve movement posted with a rationale rather than a silent system auto-zero
generic.Evidence location: Claim financials in Guidewire ClaimCenter with the movement in the claims management platform

steps.title: Read outstanding indemnity reserves per exposure
sop: Open the claim financials and read the outstanding indemnity reserve on every exposure
List any exposure carrying a non-zero indemnity reserve
Done when the indemnity reserve position is listed per exposure
verify: Re-read the financials after the closing movements are posted
Pass when no exposure carries a non-zero outstanding indemnity reserve

steps.title: Read outstanding expense and ALAE reserves
sop: Read the outstanding expense and ALAE reserve including defense and expert reserves
List any non-zero expense reserve remaining on the claim
Done when the expense reserve position is listed
verify: Re-read the expense reserve position after posting
Pass when no outstanding expense or ALAE reserve remains at closure

steps.title: Post the closing reserve movement with a rationale
sop: Post the closing reserve movement to bring outstanding reserves to zero
Record the rationale note explaining the release rather than relying on a silent auto-zero
Done when the movement is posted with a rationale note attached
verify: Open the reserve transaction and check for the attached rationale
Pass when the closing reserve movement carries a rationale note

steps.title: Test the release against handler authority
sop: Compare the reserve release amount against the handler authority limit
Route the release for approval where it exceeds the limit and record the approval
Done when every release is within authority or approved
verify: Check releases above the limit for an attached approval record
Pass when no over-authority reserve release lacks an approval record

steps.title: Check no recovery reserve remains on an active pursuit
sop: List any open recovery reserve on the claim and its pursuit status
Confirm no recovery reserve remains open where the recovery is still being pursued
Done when recovery reserve and pursuit status are reconciled
verify: Compare open recovery reserves against active recovery pursuits
Pass when no open recovery reserve sits against an active pursuit at closure

steps.title: Confirm the zero reserve position before closure
sop: Re-read the claim financials to confirm every outstanding reserve reads zero
Record the zero reserve confirmation on the claim before requesting closure
Done when the zero reserve position is confirmed and recorded
verify: Re-query the claim financial summary after the confirmation
Pass when the claim shows zero outstanding reserve across all exposures

generic.Defined scope/population: Closing claims tested against treaty retentions and facultative certificates for the policy year
generic.In-scope period: Ceded activity from the notification trigger to the closure preparation date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty or certificate reference, notification date, ceded share, billing reference and cash status populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ceded share billed reconciles to paid indemnity and allocated expense at the treaty percentage
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notification letter and billing record retained against the claim with their dates
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Outstanding receivables recorded and aged with a chaser date and owner
generic.Test population: Every closing claim exceeding a treaty retention or attaching to a facultative certificate
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a claim exceeding retention closes with no recovery billing raised
generic.Exception handling path: Unbilled recoveries block closure until the billing is raised or a waiver is recorded
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reinsurer notification issued within the contractual notification window and evidenced
generic.Evidence location: Reinsurance administration system records with the confirmation on the claim in ClaimCenter

steps.title: Test the claim against treaty retention and facultative cover
sop: Open the reinsurance administration system and identify the treaty programme for the policy year
Compare the claim incurred against the retention and check for a facultative certificate
Done when the claim is confirmed as ceded or not ceded
verify: Re-check the incurred figure used against the claim financials
Pass when the cession test uses the final incurred on the claim

steps.title: Confirm the reinsurer notification was issued in time
sop: Locate the reinsurer notification and its issue date on the claim file
Compare the issue date against the contractual notification window
Done when the notification date is confirmed and evidenced
verify: Open the notification document from the claim file
Pass when a notification document exists dated within the contractual window

steps.title: Confirm the recovery billing covers the full ceded share
sop: Recompute the ceded share of paid indemnity and allocated expense in Microsoft Excel
Compare the recomputed share against the billing raised in the reinsurance system
Done when the billing is confirmed to cover the full ceded share
verify: Re-run the recomputation after any billing adjustment
Pass when a recovery billing exists covering the full ceded share

steps.title: Confirm cash received or the receivable is aged
sop: Check whether the reinsurance cash has been received against the billing
Where outstanding, confirm the receivable is recorded and aged with a chaser date
Done when cash or an aged receivable is confirmed for every billing
verify: Re-open the receivable record and check the chaser date and owner
Pass when every outstanding receivable carries an age and a chaser date

steps.title: Record the reinsurance completion on the claim
sop: Record the reinsurance completion confirmation on the claim in ClaimCenter
Reference the notification, billing and cash or receivable position in the note
Done when the confirmation is recorded before the claim is set to Closed
verify: Query closing claims exceeding retention for a completion confirmation
Pass when no claim closes with an unbilled reinsurance recovery

steps.title: Reconcile ceded claims against the closure queue
sop: List claims closing in the period that exceed treaty retention
Compare the list against billings raised in the reinsurance administration system
Done when every ceded closing claim is matched to a billing
verify: Re-run the comparison after any late billing is raised
Pass when every ceded closing claim matches a raised recovery billing

generic.Defined scope/population: Settled exposures on the closing claim requiring executed releases and lien clearance
generic.In-scope period: Settlement documentation executed between the settlement agreement and the closure date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Release date, releasing parties, release amount, payee and lien satisfaction status populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Release amount and payee match the settlement payment actually issued on the claim
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Executed release and lien satisfactions stored in the repository with execution dates
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing or unexecuted documents logged and blocking closure until resolved
generic.Test population: Every settled exposure on the claim being closed
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a settled claim closes with an outstanding unsatisfied lien on file
generic.Exception handling path: Unsatisfied liens escalated to the examiner and resolved before the claim closes
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Court approval order present for any minor, estate or guardianship settlement
generic.Evidence location: Executed documents in OpenText Document Mgmt indexed to the claim in Guidewire ClaimCenter

steps.title: Confirm the signed release is filed for each settled exposure
sop: Locate the executed release for every settled exposure in the claim file repository
Confirm it is signed by every releasing party and carries an execution date
Done when every settled exposure has a filed executed release
verify: Open each release and check the signature blocks and date
Pass when a fully executed release is filed for each settled exposure

steps.title: Match release amount and payee to the payment issued
sop: Compare the release amount and named payee against the settlement payment in ClaimCenter
Investigate and resolve any difference before closure proceeds
Done when release terms and the issued payment agree
verify: Re-compare after any correcting payment or release amendment
Pass when the release amount and payee match the settlement payment issued

steps.title: Confirm court approval for protected settlements
sop: Identify any minor, estate or guardianship settlement on the claim
Confirm the required court approval order is filed against the claim
Done when every protected settlement carries a filed approval order
verify: Open the approval order and check it names the settlement being closed
Pass when every protected settlement has a matching court approval order

steps.title: Confirm lien satisfactions are documented
sop: List medical, Medicare and MSP, statutory and attorney liens asserted on the claim
Confirm each is documented as satisfied or formally waived
Done when every asserted lien has a satisfaction or waiver on file
verify: Compare the lien list against the filed satisfaction documents
Pass when no settled claim closes with an outstanding unsatisfied lien on file

steps.title: Confirm dismissal documents on litigated claims
sop: Identify whether the claim was in litigation at the time of settlement
Confirm the dismissal or stipulation document is filed against the claim
Done when every litigated settled claim has its dismissal filed
verify: Open the dismissal document and check the case reference matches
Pass when every litigated settled claim carries a filed dismissal or stipulation

steps.title: Index closing documents in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Index the release, approval order, lien satisfactions and dismissal to the claim number
Confirm each retrieves by claim number from the document system
Done when every closing document is indexed and retrievable
verify: Search by claim number and count the returned closing documents
Pass when every closing document retrieves by claim number

generic.Defined scope/population: Reopened exposures requiring a fresh coverage determination on the merits
generic.In-scope period: From the reopen date through to the recorded coverage determination
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy version at date of loss, endorsements, reopened element and determination outcome populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reopened exposures count equals coverage determinations recorded for the claim
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: New coverage position document filed with a date after the reopen date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reopened exposures above handler authority logged and referred for technical sign-off
generic.Test population: Every reopened exposure adjudicated in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a reopened claim is adjudicated on the original coverage memo alone
generic.Exception handling path: Contested or ambiguous coverage referred to technical or legal review before the position issues
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Determination cites the policy provisions relied on and the supplemental findings
generic.Evidence location: Coverage determination in the claim file repository linked to the claim in ClaimCenter

steps.title: Re-read the policy in force at the date of loss
sop: Open the policy version in force at the date of loss including all endorsements
Identify the provisions relevant to the reopened element
Done when the applicable provisions are identified and recorded
verify: Compare the policy version used against the date of loss on the claim
Pass when the coverage analysis uses the policy in force at the date of loss

steps.title: Assess continuation versus new occurrence
sop: Compare the reopened loss facts against the original loss facts on the file
Determine whether it is a continuation of the original claim or a new occurrence
Done when the continuation or new occurrence conclusion is documented
verify: Check the conclusion is supported by the compared facts
Pass when the continuation conclusion cites the facts it relies on

steps.title: Test the reopened element against exclusions and limits
sop: Test the reopened element against exclusions, sublimits and aggregate erosion from the original payment
Compute the remaining limit available for the reopened element
Done when the remaining limit and any applicable exclusion are recorded
verify: Recompute the aggregate erosion from the payment history
Pass when the remaining limit agrees with the recomputed erosion

steps.title: Document the coverage determination in ClaimCenter
sop: Write the coverage determination citing the policy provisions relied on
Reference the supplemental investigation findings supporting the position
Done when the determination is documented with citations and findings
verify: Read the determination for policy citations and findings references
Pass when the determination cites both provisions and supplemental findings

steps.title: Obtain technical referral sign-off above authority
sop: Compare the reopened exposure value against the handler authority level
Route for coverage or technical referral sign-off where it exceeds authority
Done when every over-authority determination carries a recorded sign-off
verify: Check over-authority determinations for an attached sign-off
Pass when no over-authority coverage position issues without sign-off

steps.title: File the new coverage position to the claim file repository
sop: Save the new coverage position document to the repository under the claim number
Confirm the document date falls after the reopen date
Done when the new coverage position is filed and dated after reopen
verify: Retrieve the document and compare its date against the reopen date
Pass when a coverage position document exists dated after the reopen date

generic.Defined scope/population: All claims reopened in the period across lines, teams and adjusters
generic.In-scope period: Reopens occurring within the current analysis period with prior period comparison
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Original closure date, reopen date, days-closed interval and reopen driver category populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reopened claim count equals the sum of claims across the driver categories
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Analysis saved with the data cut date and the driver taxonomy version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reopens with no assignable driver logged and returned to the handler for classification
generic.Test population: Every claim reopened in the analysis period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Flag reopens within 30 days of closure as a premature-closure indicator
generic.Exception handling path: Top drivers handed to the quality and training owners with exemplar claims
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reopen rate reported by line, team and adjuster with prior period comparison
generic.Evidence location: Analysis in the BI reporting platform sourced from the enterprise data warehouse

steps.title: Extract reopened claims from the data warehouse
sop: Extract all claims reopened in the period with original closure date and reopen date
Compute the days-closed interval for each reopened claim
Done when the reopen extract is produced with intervals computed
verify: Reconcile the extract count against the reopened-claims report in ClaimCenter
Pass when the extract count equals the system reopened claim count

steps.title: Categorise each reopen driver
sop: Assign each reopen a driver from the taxonomy: premature closure, missed recovery, late supplemental damage, litigation, medical deterioration or error
Return reopens with no assignable driver to the handler for classification
Done when every reopened claim carries a driver category
verify: Filter the extract for blank driver categories
Pass when each reopened claim carries a categorised reopen driver

steps.title: Compute reopen rate by line, team and adjuster
sop: Compute the reopen rate as reopens over claims closed for each line, team and adjuster
Compare each rate against the prior period on the same definition
Done when reopen rates and prior period comparisons are computed
verify: Reconcile the denominators against the closed claim counts
Pass when reopen rate is reported by line, team and adjuster with prior period comparison

steps.title: Isolate reopens within 30 days of closure
sop: Filter the extract for reopens occurring within 30 days of the original closure
Quantify these separately as the premature-closure indicator
Done when the premature-closure population is quantified
verify: Recompute the days-closed interval on the isolated population
Pass when every claim in the premature-closure population has an interval under 30 days

steps.title: Document the top drivers with claim exemplars
sop: Rank the drivers by volume and by reopened exposure value
Document the top drivers with exemplar claim numbers demonstrating each
Done when the top drivers are documented with exemplars
verify: Open each exemplar claim to confirm it shows the stated driver
Pass when every exemplar claim demonstrates its stated reopen driver

steps.title: Review the analysis and direct the response
sop: Review the driver ranking, rates and premature-closure indicator
Direct the response and name the quality and training owners for the top drivers
Done when owners are named for the top reopen drivers
verify: Confirm each named owner has accepted the driver handover
Pass when every top driver has an accepting named owner

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims reopened in the period requiring an ownership assignment
generic.In-scope period: From the reopen status change to the recorded assignment date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reopened exposure value, required authority level, claim owner, supervisor and assignment date populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reopened claim count equals the count with a current owner assigned
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assignment recorded with the assignment date and the assigning user
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims that cannot be assigned within the standard logged with the reason and escalation
generic.Test population: Every claim reopened in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a large-loss reopened claim is assigned below the required authority level
generic.Exception handling path: Error-driven reopens routed away from the original handler to an independent handler
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Handler skill and authority set from the reopened exposure value and complexity
generic.Evidence location: Assignment record on the claim in Guidewire ClaimCenter and the claims management platform

steps.title: Assess the reopened exposure value and complexity
sop: Read the reopen reason and the estimated reopened exposure on the claim
Determine the handler skill and authority level the file now requires
Done when the required skill and authority level are recorded
verify: Compare the recorded requirement against the exposure estimate
Pass when the required authority level matches the reopened exposure band

steps.title: Test whether the original handler is appropriate
sop: Check whether the original handler remains available and whether the reopen is error-driven
Route back to the original handler only where they are available and the reopen is not error-driven
Done when the original handler routing decision is recorded
verify: Check error-driven reopens against the assigned handler
Pass when no error-driven reopen is routed back to the handler who caused it

steps.title: Route large-loss reopens to a senior handler
sop: Compare the reopened exposure against the large-loss threshold
Route files above the threshold to a senior or complex-loss handler
Done when every above-threshold reopen is routed to a senior handler
verify: Compare assigned handler authority against the reopened exposure
Pass when no reopened claim above the large-loss threshold sits below the required authority

steps.title: Set the claim owner and supervisor in ClaimCenter
sop: Set the claim owner and the supervising manager on the reopened claim
Confirm the assignment date is recorded on the claim
Done when owner, supervisor and assignment date are set
verify: Compare the assignment date against the reopen date
Pass when the reopened claim shows a current owner with an assignment date after reopen

steps.title: Notify the assigned handler with the reopen context
sop: Send the assigned handler the reopen reason and the original file summary
Record the notification against the claim so the handover is evidenced
Done when the assigned handler is notified and the notification recorded
verify: Check the notification record exists on every newly assigned reopen
Pass when every reopened claim shows a recorded handler notification

steps.title: Accept the assignment and confirm capacity
sop: Review the reopen reason, exposure and original file summary on assignment
Confirm acceptance or raise a capacity or authority concern to the examiner
Done when the assignment is accepted or a concern is raised
verify: Check newly assigned reopens for an acceptance or raised concern
Pass when every reopened assignment shows an acceptance or a raised concern

generic.Defined scope/population: Reopened claims with a coverage decision requiring communication to the insured or claimant
generic.In-scope period: From the coverage determination to the letter send date within the regulatory window
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loss state deadline, decision date, letter send date and policy provisions cited populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Coverage determinations recorded equals coverage position letters issued and filed
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued letter filed against the claim with the send date recorded
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Letters issued outside the deadline logged with the reason and compliance disposition
generic.Test population: All reopened coverage decisions communicated in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where the letter send date falls outside the loss-state regulatory window
generic.Exception handling path: Late or at-risk letters escalated to compliance before the deadline expires
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Denial letters state the policy provisions relied on and any required appeal rights
generic.Evidence location: Issued letter in the claim file repository with the diary record in Guidewire ClaimCenter

steps.title: Identify and diary the loss-state deadline
sop: Identify the loss-state deadline applying to the reopened coverage decision
Set a diary entry in ClaimCenter ahead of the deadline
Done when the deadline is identified and diarised
verify: Compare the diarised date against the state requirement
Pass when the diary date falls before the regulatory deadline

steps.title: Draft the coverage position letter in plain language
sop: Draft the letter stating the decision in plain language
Cite the policy provisions the decision relies on
Done when the draft states the decision and its policy basis
verify: Read the draft for the decision statement and provision citations
Pass when the draft states the decision and cites the provisions relied on

steps.title: Include appeal and complaint rights where required
sop: Check whether the state or policy requires appeal, review or complaint rights on a denial
Insert the required rights wording into the draft where applicable
Done when required rights wording is present or confirmed not required
verify: Compare the letter against the state denial content requirement
Pass when every denial letter carries the required rights wording

steps.title: Issue the letter to the insured and any attorney
sop: Issue the letter to the insured and, where applicable, the claimant attorney
Record the send date and the recipients on the claim
Done when the letter is issued and the send date recorded
verify: Compare the send date against the regulatory deadline
Pass when the letter is sent inside the regulatory window

steps.title: File the issued letter against the claim
sop: File the issued letter in the claim file repository under the claim number
Confirm the filed copy shows the send date
Done when the issued letter is filed with its send date
verify: Retrieve the letter by claim number from the repository
Pass when the coverage position letter is filed with a send date inside the window

steps.title: Close the diary entry in ClaimCenter
sop: Close the regulatory decision diary once the letter is issued and filed
Record the completion note referencing the letter and send date
Done when the diary entry is closed with a completion note
verify: Query open decision diaries on reopened claims with issued letters
Pass when no decision diary remains open after the letter is issued

generic.Defined scope/population: Reopened claims requiring supplemental investigation of the newly asserted loss element
generic.In-scope period: Investigation activity from the reopen date to the documented findings
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Investigation question, new evidence references, expert assignment and reconciliation note populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: New evidence items obtained equals evidence items indexed to the claim
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: New evidence indexed to the claim with obtained dates after the reopen date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Evidence requested but not obtained logged with the chase status and disposition
generic.Test population: Every reopened claim undergoing supplemental investigation in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where findings are recorded with no new evidence obtained after the reopen date
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed supplemental damage referred to an expert or re-inspection with the assignment recorded
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A note reconciles supplemental findings against the original investigation
generic.Evidence location: Evidence in the claim file repository with investigation notes in Guidewire ClaimCenter

steps.title: Define the supplemental investigation question
sop: Define the specific question the supplemental investigation must answer
Record the question on the claim so the scope is bounded and testable
Done when the investigation question is documented on the claim
verify: Read the recorded question for specificity
Pass when the recorded question names the specific issue to resolve

steps.title: Obtain the new evidence supporting the reopen
sop: Request the supplemental estimate, new medical records or new damage photographs

steps.title: Compare new evidence against the original findings

generic.Defined scope/population: Reopen requests requiring a limitation and contractual filing period assessment
generic.In-scope period: From the date of loss through to the reopen request receipt date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Date of loss, original denial or closure date, tolling events and computed expiry date populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reopen requests assessed equals reopen requests with a recorded limitation conclusion
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Limitation note recorded on the claim with the dates relied on and the assessment date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Arguable or time-barred positions logged and referred to counsel with the referral recorded
generic.Test population: Every reopen request received in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a time-barred claim is reopened without a documented legal referral
generic.Exception handling path: Time-barred and borderline positions referred to counsel before the reopen proceeds
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Conclusion states open or time-barred with the specific dates relied on
generic.Evidence location: Limitation note in Guidewire ClaimCenter with supporting documents in the claim file repository

steps.title: Identify the key dates on the claim file
sop: Record the date of loss, the original denial or closure date and any tolling events
Locate the documents evidencing each date in the claim file repository
Done when every key date is recorded with an evidencing document
verify: Open the evidencing document for each recorded date
Pass when every recorded date is supported by a document in the file

steps.title: Apply the loss-state statute of limitations
sop: Identify the loss-state limitation period for the cause of action
Compute the expiry date from the applicable trigger date
Done when the computed expiry date is recorded
verify: Recompute the expiry date from the recorded trigger
Pass when the recorded expiry date matches the recomputed date

steps.title: Check the policy suit-limitation clause
sop: Read the policy contractual suit-limitation and proof-of-loss clauses
Determine whether either shortens the statutory period and record the effect
Done when the contractual position is recorded alongside the statutory date
verify: Compare the contractual and statutory dates recorded
Pass when the earlier of the contractual and statutory dates governs the conclusion

steps.title: Check for extensions, tolling agreements and waivers
sop: Search the file for any written extension, tolling agreement or waiver
Adjust the computed expiry date for any document found and record it
Done when the effect of every such document is recorded
verify: Open each identified agreement and check the dates it changes
Pass when every extension or tolling document found is reflected in the expiry date

steps.title: Record the open or time-barred conclusion
sop: Record the conclusion as open or time-barred on the claim
State the dates relied on and the computation used to reach it
Done when the conclusion and its supporting dates are recorded
verify: Read the note for the expiry date and the dates relied on
Pass when the note records the computed limitation expiry date and its inputs

steps.title: Refer arguable positions to counsel
sop: Refer any arguable or time-barred position to counsel before the reopen proceeds
Record the referral date and the counsel response on the claim
Done when every arguable position carries a recorded referral
verify: Check reopened time-barred claims for a referral record
Pass when no time-barred claim is reopened without a documented legal referral

generic.Defined scope/population: All requests to reopen a closed claim received in the period
generic.In-scope period: From request receipt to the recorded reopen or decline decision
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Requester, receipt date, stated basis, assessment and decision populated on every request
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Requests received equals requests reopened plus requests declined plus requests pending
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Request record and supporting material retained with the receipt date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests lacking new information logged with the decline reason and notification date

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a request is declined without a documented reason and requester notification
generic.Exception handling path: Borderline requests escalated to the examiner for a documented judgement
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assessment states whether the new information could change the outcome
generic.Evidence location: Reopen request record in Guidewire ClaimCenter with material in the claim file repository

steps.title: Log the reopen request in Guidewire ClaimCenter
sop: Create the reopen request record with requester, receipt date and stated basis
Attach the request correspondence and any supporting material
Done when the request record is created with its basis recorded
verify: Filter request records for missing requester or receipt date
Pass when every request record shows requester, receipt date and stated basis

steps.title: Test whether the request rests on new information
sop: Compare the stated basis against the facts already decided on the closed file
Confirm the request is supported by new information rather than a restatement
Done when the new-information conclusion is recorded
verify: Check the conclusion cites the specific new information identified
Pass when every new-information conclusion names the information relied on

steps.title: Review the original closure documentation
sop: Open the original closure documentation to establish what was decided and paid
Record the original decision and payment position on the request record
Done when the original position is recorded on the request
verify: Compare the recorded position against the claim financial history
Pass when the recorded original position agrees with the claim history

steps.title: Assess whether the outcome could change
sop: Assess whether the new information, if accepted, could change the original outcome
Document the assessment and the reasoning on the request record
Done when the assessment is documented on the request
verify: Read the assessment for a stated conclusion and reasoning
Pass when every request carries a documented outcome-impact assessment

steps.title: Record the reopen or decline decision
sop: Record the decision to reopen or decline against the request record
State the reason supporting the decision taken
Done when the decision and its reason are recorded
verify: Filter declined requests for a blank reason field
Pass when no reopen request is declined without a documented reason

steps.title: Notify the requester within the standard turnaround
sop: Notify the requester of the decision and the reasons within the standard turnaround
File the notification against the claim and record the notification date
Done when the requester is notified and the notification is filed
verify: Compare the notification date against the receipt date and the standard
Pass when every decision is notified inside the standard turnaround

generic.Defined scope/population: Closure standards and checklist items implicated by the categorised reopen drivers
generic.In-scope period: Reopen drivers from the current analysis cycle informing the standards update
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Driver category, failing checklist item, proposed amendment, approver and effective date populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Driver categories analysed equals checklist items assessed for amendment
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Amended standard published with version, approval record and effective date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Drivers with no preventable checklist control logged with the alternative control proposed
generic.Test population: Every categorised reopen driver from the analysis cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a new checklist item is published as advisory rather than mandatory
generic.Exception handling path: Amendments failing the back-test returned for redesign before publication
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Current closure standard version cites the reopen analysis that drove the change
generic.Evidence location: Closure standard in the claim file repository with configuration in Guidewire ClaimCenter

steps.title: Map each reopen driver to a failing closure control
sop: Take the categorised reopen drivers from the analysis
Identify which closure checklist item failed to prevent each driver
Done when every driver is mapped to a checklist item or logged as uncontrolled
verify: Check each mapping against the current checklist content
Pass when every mapped item exists on the current closure checklist

steps.title: Draft the closure standard amendment
sop: Draft the checklist or standard amendment that would have caught the driver
Write the item as a testable control such as a mandatory subrogation sign-off
Done when every mapped driver has a drafted amendment
verify: Read each draft for testability
Pass when every drafted item states a testable condition

steps.title: Back-test the amendment against recent reopens
sop: Select a sample of recent reopens matching the driver category
Test whether the proposed amendment would have prevented each
Done when the back-test result is recorded for each amendment
verify: Check the back-test sample size and prevention rate recorded
Pass when every published amendment carries a recorded back-test result

steps.title: Obtain claims leadership approval
sop: Review the amendment, the driver evidence and the back-test result
Approve or reject each amendment and record the decision and date
Done when every amendment carries an approval decision
verify: Check the approval date precedes publication
Pass when no amendment is published without a prior recorded approval

steps.title: Publish the amended closure standard
sop: Publish the amended standard to the claim file repository with an effective date
Cite the reopen analysis that drove the change in the version notes
Done when the amended standard is published with its citation
verify: Open the published version and read the version notes
Pass when the current closure standard version cites the reopen analysis

steps.title: Configure the new checklist item as mandatory in ClaimCenter
sop: Update the system closure checklist configuration with the new item
Set the item as mandatory so it blocks closure rather than advising
Done when the item is configured as mandatory in the system
verify: Attempt a test closure leaving the new item unanswered
Pass when the new checklist item blocks closure until answered

steps.title: Recalculate the additional amount owed
sop: Recalculate the additional amount from the supplemental evaluation
Document the calculation components on the reopened exposure
Done when the calculation is documented with its components
verify: Recompute the total from the documented components
Pass when the documented total equals the recomputed components

steps.title: Test the amount against handler settlement authority
sop: Compare the additional amount against the handler settlement authority
Obtain and record the approval where the amount exceeds authority

verify: Check over-authority payments for an attached approval record
Pass when no supplemental payment exceeds handler authority without an approval record

steps.title: Verify payee, tax and lien interests before release
sop: Verify the payee details and tax information against the claim records

Done when payee, tax and interest details are verified
verify: Re-check the payee instruction against the identified interests

steps.title: Issue the additional payment in the payment system
sop: Issue the additional payment against the reopened exposure
Confirm the payment reaches Issued status in the disbursement system
Done when the payment shows Issued status
verify: Re-query the payment status in the payment subrogation system
Pass when the additional payment is recorded against the reopened exposure

steps.title: Issue the written supplemental denial where declining
sop: Where declining, draft the written denial of the supplemental claim
Cite the policy provision relied on and file the letter against the claim
Done when the supplemental denial is issued and filed
verify: Read the filed denial for the policy provision citation
Pass when every supplemental denial cites the policy provision relied on

steps.title: Record the disposition on the reopened exposure
sop: Record the payment or denial disposition against the reopened exposure
Attach the calculation, approval and payment or letter reference
Done when the disposition is recorded with its supporting attachments
verify: Re-open the exposure record and check the attachments
Pass when every reopened exposure shows a recorded and evidenced disposition

generic.Defined scope/population: Reopened claims that have reached final supplemental disposition and are ready to re-close
generic.In-scope period: From the final supplemental disposition to the recorded re-closure date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Checklist answers, reopened reserve, supplemental payment status, re-closure code and reopen count populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reopened exposures equals exposures re-closed with zero outstanding reserve

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Full closure checklist rerun rather than relying on the original closure
generic.Evidence location: Claim record in Guidewire ClaimCenter with documents in the claim file repository

steps.title: Rerun the complete closure checklist in ClaimCenter
sop: Open a fresh closure checklist on the reopened claim
Answer every item against the current file rather than the original closure
Done when every checklist item is answered afresh
verify: Compare the checklist completion timestamp against the reopen date
Pass when the checklist answers are dated after the reopen date

steps.title: Confirm the reopened reserve is zero
sop: Read the outstanding indemnity and expense reserves on the reopened exposures
Post the closing movement so every reopened exposure reads zero
Done when the reopened reserve position reads zero
verify: Re-read the claim financials after the movement
Pass when no reopened exposure carries a non-zero outstanding reserve

steps.title: Confirm supplemental payments are Issued
sop: List the supplemental payments raised since the reopen
Confirm each shows Issued status in the disbursement system
Done when every supplemental payment shows Issued status
verify: Re-query the supplemental payment statuses
Pass when no supplemental payment remains in a pending status at re-closure

steps.title: Confirm new release or dismissal documents are filed
sop: Confirm any new release, supplemental release or dismissal covering the reopened element is executed
File each document in the claim file repository under the claim number
Done when every required re-closure document is executed and filed
verify: Retrieve each document by claim number from the repository
Pass when every required re-closure document retrieves from the repository

steps.title: Record the lessons-learned note
sop: Write the lessons-learned note stating why the claim reopened
State what closure step would have prevented the reopen
Done when the lessons-learned note is recorded on the claim
verify: Read the note for the reopen cause and the prevention point
Pass when a lessons-learned note is recorded on the re-closed claim

steps.title: Apply the re-closure code and confirm the reopen count
sop: Apply the re-closure code and set the re-closure date on the claim
Confirm the claim shows a reopen count greater than zero
Done when the re-closure code, date and reopen count are set
verify: Re-query the claim for reopen count and re-closure date
Pass when the re-closed claim shows a reopen count above zero and a re-closure date

steps.title: Locate the original claim and check for duplicates

Search for any duplicate claim already created for the same loss and policy

sop: Set the claim status to Reopen in the claims management platform

sop: Record the reopen date on the claim record

verify: Compare the recorded reopen date against the decision record

sop: Run the reopened-claims report for the period

generic.Defined scope/population: Reopened exposures requiring indemnity and expense reserves to be restored or established

verify: Re-run the comparison after any correcting transaction

verify: Re-list open diaries and check assignee status

sop: Review the claim for the contact, investigation, reserve review and decision diaries
